lines.en: label otohaspring5:
scene noonsky
There’s a place in Kumon-mi that’s always dark.
lines.zh: Kumon-mi 有个地方永远是暗的。

lines.en: A place the light can not reach for reasons unrelated to God or god or however you’re feeling today.
lines.zh: 一个光到不了的地方，原因跟上帝或者神或者你今天心情如何无关。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo1
That place is just a sketchy basement, though. So take that stupid tin foil hat off and get back in the game. Both literally and figuratively.
lines.zh: 不过那地方就是个不太正经的地下室。所以把你那顶蠢兮兮的锡纸帽摘了，回到正题上来吧。字面意义和比喻意义上都是。

lines.en: : Aaaaaaaaaah-
: Not loud enough.
lines.zh: : 不够响。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo2
: Aaaaaaaaaahhhhh-
: Still not impressed. Gonna need some more.
lines.zh: : 还是不够惊艳。再来点。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo3
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH-
: Pathetic. Is this your first time singing? Were you literally just born?
lines.zh: : 惨不忍睹。这是你第一次唱歌吗？你他妈是刚出生吗？

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo4
: Jesus, Niki! Some pointers might help if you’re that {i}unimpressed!{/i} It’d be better than just lying there and bitching at me all afternoon, that’s for sure!
lines.zh: : 天啊，Niki！你既然这么{i}不满意{/i}，给点指点总行吧！总比躺在那儿整个下午对我骂骂咧咧强吧，这是肯定的！

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo5
: What do I know about singing? I’m just some idiot who threw her career away for some dude who’s probably going to fuck you {i}and{/i} my entire agency by the end of the year.
lines.zh: : 我懂什么唱歌？我不过是个为了某个男人把事业扔掉的蠢货，而那个男人大概年底之前就会把你{i}和{/i}我整个事务所都操一遍。

lines.en: : Don’t be ridiculous, Niki. Akira and I are at least {i}two{/i} years away from that sort of development.
lines.zh: : 别犯傻了，Niki。Akira 和我要走到那一步，至少还有{i}两{/i}年呢。

lines.en: : Why is life so miserable, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 人生为什么这么惨啊，Otoha？

lines.en: : Oh, was today your therapy session? Sorry. I thought I had singing lessons again. You know, that thing my parents are paying you for?
lines.zh: : 哦，今天是我的心理疗程吗？抱歉。我还以为今天又是声乐课呢。就是我爸妈付钱让你教的那个？

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo6
: Nobody’s paying me for your lessons, {i}brat.{/i} I’m doing this out of the kindness of my heart, remember?
lines.zh: : 没人付钱让我教你，{i}小鬼{/i}。我是出于好心才这么做的，记得吗？

lines.en: : My bad. I must have forgotten that on account of Akira seemingly fucking all of that kindness out of you. Now, can we get back to improving my dynamics?
lines.zh: : 我的错。我准是忘了——毕竟 Akira 好像把你那份好心全他妈操没了。好了，我们能回到改善我的强弱处理上了吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Just, instead of “ahhhhhh,” can you go ahead and yell “Niki Nakayama is a fucking moron” this time? As loud as you possibly can for as long as you can. I want to make sure I hear it.
lines.zh: : 行。不过这次别"啊————"了，你能不能改成吼"Niki Nakayama 是个大蠢货"？用你最大的声音，能吼多久吼多久。我得确保自己听见。

lines.en: : Sounds easy enough when I’ve been doing that internally ever since I saw your stupid Instagram post.
lines.zh: : 听起来倒不难，反正自从看到你那条蠢 Instagram 之后，我心里就一直在吼这句了。

lines.en: : I knew the backlash would be bad but I didn’t think it’d be {i}this{/i} bad. And I’m sure it doesn’t help that I’m now personally intimidating girls who claim to be my biggest fan either.
lines.zh: : 我知道反击会很糟，但没想到会糟到{i}这个{/i}地步。而且我现在还亲自去恐吓那些自称是我头号粉丝的女孩，想来也没什么帮助。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo7
: If this is about Chika again, I don’t think you need to feel as bad as you probably do. She’s been kind of weirdly okay following your little confrontation.
lines.zh: : 如果又是为了 Chika 的事，我觉得你不必像现在这样自责。你们那次小小对峙之后，她状态出奇地还行。

lines.en: : So what? Doesn’t mean I wasn’t too hard on her.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？不代表我当时对她下手不重。

lines.en: : She’s sleeping with your boyfriend. Like, actively. Maybe even right now. Possibly with a poster of you ominously hanging in the background as if you are observing their collective sin.
lines.zh: : 她在跟你男朋友上床。就在进行中。说不定这会儿就在上。背景里说不定还挂着你的海报，阴森森的，像是在注视着他们共同的罪孽。

lines.en: : Good. I hope my two-dimensional visage haunts that man every time he accidentally looks away from her hot teen body.
lines.zh: : 很好。我希望我那张二维的脸每次在他不小心把视线从她火辣的少女身体上移开时，都能缠住那个男人。

lines.en: : How come you never tell me I have a hot teen body?
lines.zh: : 你怎么从来不说我有一具火辣的少女身体？

lines.en: : Because you raped me and I don’t think you’re cute anymore.
lines.zh: : 因为你强奸了我，而且我觉得你不可爱了。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo8
: I did not {i}rape{/i} you! I just...you know...did that thing we’re not really supposed to talk about anymore on account of me apparently not having a hot enough teen body.
lines.zh: : 我才没有{i}强奸{/i}你！我只是……你知道的……做了那件我们说好不再提的事——而理由显然是我没有一具足够火辣的少女身体。

lines.en: : Oh, cry me a river. I have enough problems between an ongoing legal battle and a {i}developing{/i} one at home to bother consoling you about the fact that we are never going to have sex.
lines.zh: : 哦，哭给我看啊。我手头已经有一场还在打的官司，家里还有一场{i}正在发酵{/i}的，哪有空来安慰你"我们永远不会上床"这件事。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo9
: If you’re that set on fucking a teacher, you have plenty of access to a different one. Do I {i}enjoy{/i} that you have this access? No! But you know what I enjoy even {i}less,{/i} Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你要是这么想操老师，你有的是机会找另一位。我{i}乐意{/i}你有这种机会吗？不乐意！但你知道我更{i}不{/i}乐意什么吗，Otoha？

lines.en: : His daughter having that same access and an even greater desire to fuck him than you do?
lines.zh: : 是他女儿也有同样的机会，而且想操他的心思比你还要重？

lines.en: : His fucking {i}daughter{/i} having an even {i}greater{/i} desire to- wait, how’d you know what I was going to say?
lines.zh: : 他那该死的{i}女儿{/i}有更{i}重{/i}的心思——等等，你怎么知道我要说什么？

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo10
: Because you never fucking shut up about it! Everything lately is just Ami, this! Sensei, that! Just friggin’ mentor me if you’re so opposed to having any other sort of relationship with me, Niki!
lines.zh: : 因为你他妈说起这个就没完没了！最近张口闭口就是 Ami 这样、老师那样！Niki，你要是这么抗拒跟我发展别的关系，干脆就他妈好好当我的导师啊！

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo11
: I’m sorry, Otoha. I have neglected you. Would you like a hug?
lines.zh: : 对不起，Otoha。是我冷落你了。想要个拥抱吗？

lines.en: : This is a trick question. No. I would not.
lines.zh: : 这是个陷阱题。不要。我不想要。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo12
: Damn it. I could really use one right now.
lines.zh: : 该死。我现在真的需要一个。

lines.en: : Wait, no! I changed my mind! I {i}do{/i} want one!
lines.zh: : 等等，不！我改主意了！我{i}要{/i}！

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo13
: Get your mind out of the fucking gutter, Otoha! How dare you even {i}think{/i} of accepting such a blatantly predatory gesture! Have you lost your fucking marbles?!
lines.zh: : 把你脑子里那些脏东西清一清，Otoha！你怎么{i}敢{/i}去想接受这么一个明摆着是捕食者的举动！你他妈脑子进水了吗？！

lines.en: : No! You’re just a really confusing person when you get angry and I don’t know if I’m supposed to cheer you up or give you space!
lines.zh: : 没有！只是你一生气就特别让人摸不着头脑，我不知道该哄你开心还是给你空间！

lines.en: : Neither! You’re supposed to be focusing on {i}singing!{/i} Not me!
lines.zh: : 都不要！你应该把注意力放在{i}唱歌{/i}上！不是我！

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo14
: WHAT DO YOU THINK I’VE BEEN TRYING TO DO THIS WHOLE TIME?!?!?
lines.zh: : 那你以为我这半天一直在努力做什么？！？！？

lines.en: : I swear, this would all be so much easier if I could just figure out how to get through to that red-headed demon child. Why won’t she just fucking accept me, Otoha? I’ve tried fucking {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我发誓，只要我能搞明白怎么跟那个红头发的恶魔小孩沟通，这一切都会简单得多。她为什么就是不肯接受我呢，Otoha？我他妈{i}什么招{/i}都试过了。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo15
: Everything except the one thing you know would actually {i}do{/i} something, you mean.
lines.zh: : 你是说，除了那件你明知真正{i}管用{/i}的事之外，什么都试过了。

lines.en: : Ahh. Yes, I did think of that as well. I don’t think lobotomies are legal anymore, though.
lines.zh: : 啊。那个我也想到了。不过我觉得脑白质切除术现在应该不合法了。

lines.en: : I meant letting her fuck her dad without grounding her over it.
lines.zh: : 我指的是别因为她操她爸就禁她足。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo16
: No! I’d rather just do the lobotomy! Ami already lost her first set of parents, Otoha! The last thing she needs is the second set turning her into a cum-sock!
lines.zh: : 不！我宁愿做脑白质切除术！Ami 已经失去过第一任父母了，Otoha！她最不需要的就是第二任父母把她变成一只装精的袜子！

lines.en: : I think she might like being a cum-sock, though. It feels like that’s exactly what she’s been training for.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得她可能会喜欢当一只装精的袜子。感觉她一直在训练的就是这个。

lines.en: : What she {i}wants{/i} isn’t what she needs! It’s like you and singing from your head instead of your chest! How many times have I told you not to do that today?!
lines.zh: : 她{i}想要{/i}的不是她{i}需要{/i}的！就像你唱歌用头腔而不是胸腔一样！我今天跟你说了多少次别那么唱了？！

lines.en: : Zero. This is the first bit of singing advice I have received in a month. I’m so happy, I could cry.
lines.zh: : 零次。这是我一个月来收到的第一条唱歌建议。我高兴得都快哭了。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo17
: Hah...listen. I’m sorry, okay? I know you’re probably annoyed having to put up with all of this. It’s just...I’ve never been good at dealing with...romantic drama.
lines.zh: : 哈……听着。对不起，好吗？我知道你大概受够了要忍受这些。只是……我从来都不擅长应付……感情上的狗血。

lines.en: : You’ve chosen a hell of a guy to spend the rest of your life with then.
lines.zh: : 那你可真是挑了个不得了的男人共度余生。

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}choose{/i} him, Otoha. It just happened, okay? And it’ll happen to you one day too when you stop being so obsessed with me.
lines.zh: : 我不是{i}挑{/i}了他，Otoha。就是那么发生了，好吗？等你哪天不再这么迷恋我，你也会遇上的。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo18
: Yeah, I don’t know about that. I’ve learned that I have basically the same taste in girls as Akira and he gets to all of them first. It’s totally unfair.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那可不好说。我发现我跟 Akira 喜欢的女生类型基本一样，而他却总是先得手。太不公平了。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s best if we just...keep your lessons on hold until I’m at a better place mentally? Because I’m clearly incapable of leaving my baggage at the door and need {i}somebody{/i} to vent to.
lines.zh: : 也许我们最好……暂时停一停你的课，等我精神状态好一点？因为我显然没法把包袱留在门外，需要找个{i}人{/i}倾诉。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo19
: What, do you seriously not have anybody else to vent to? No...friends or anything? Just me?
lines.zh: : 什么，你真的没有别的人可以倾诉吗？没有……朋友什么的？只有我？

lines.en: : Not lately. Ado-chan’s so busy now. I can never get a hold of her anymore.
lines.zh: : 最近没有。Ado-chan 现在太忙了。我再也联系不上她了。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo20
: A...Like...Like {i}the-{/i}
lines.zh: : A……就是……就是{i}那个——{/i}

lines.en: : Otoha, do you want to go out to dinner tonight? As like a...thanks for dealing with my bullshit gesture?
lines.zh: : Otoha，你今晚想出去吃个饭吗？就当是……谢谢你忍受我这些破事的表示？

lines.en: : I...hold on...I’m still processing the...first thing you said...
lines.zh: : 我……等等……我还在消化……你说的第一件事……

lines.en: : What, the Ado thing? Have I really never told you that before? We used to be karaoke buddies before Kumon-mi got closed off. We helped each other a lot when we were first starting out.
lines.zh: : 什么，Ado 的事？我真从没跟你说过吗？在 Kumon-mi 被封锁之前，我们以前是唱卡拉 OK 的搭子。刚出道那会儿我们互相帮了不少。

lines.en: : Sooooo...dinner?
lines.zh: : 那——吃饭？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Yeah, I’ll go to dinner with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我跟你去吃饭。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo21
{i}Five hours later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}五小时后……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Not{/i} what I had in mind...
lines.zh: : {i}可{/i}不是我想的那种……

lines.en: : Oh! Otoha’s here for some reason. Weird.
lines.zh: : 哦！Otoha 怎么也在。怪了。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo22
: Yay! Now, we can have a totally normal family dinner where we can all talk about normal things and there will be no drama at all!
lines.zh: : 耶！现在我们可以吃一顿完全正常的家庭晚餐了，大家聊聊正常的事，一点狗血都不会有！

lines.en: : Welcome to the family, Otoha. I am sorry.
lines.zh: : 欢迎加入这个家，Otoha。我很抱歉。

lines.en: : If you guys are adopting me, does that I mean I need to be into incest as well?
lines.zh: : 如果你们是要收养我，那是不是意味着我也得喜欢乱伦？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo23

: NO! No incest at the dinner table! Especially a dinner table that isn’t actually {i}our{/i} dinner table! Who knows how much longer I’ll be able to afford fancy places like this?! Savor it while you can, demon!
lines.zh: : 不！餐桌上不许聊乱伦！尤其是这张餐桌其实根本不{i}是{/i}我们的餐桌！谁知道我还能供得起这种高级地方多久？！趁还能吃好好品味吧，恶魔！

lines.en: : Hey. Quiet. You’ve got enough media attention as-is.
lines.zh: : 嘿。安静点。你身上的媒体关注已经够多了。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo24
: {i}Ahem.{/i} Yes, babe. You are absolutely right. I am not overwhelmed at all. I am Niki Nakayama. I am famous and talented and in love with my childhood friend.
lines.zh: : {i}咳。{/i} 好的，亲爱的。你说得完全对。我一点都没有崩溃。我是 Niki Nakayama。我有名、有才，还爱着我青梅竹马的那个人。

lines.en: : Sexburger!
lines.zh: : 性汉堡！

lines.en: : And soon, I will die.
lines.zh: : 而且很快，我就要死了。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo25
: Friends of the Friend-boy! Have you been writing inside of the lines lately?
lines.zh: : 朋友之友的男伴！你最近有好好在线内涂色吗？

lines.en: : Hi, Kaori...
lines.zh: : 嗨，Kaori……

lines.en: : I thought she was off today...
lines.zh: : 我以为她今天休息……

lines.en: : Is no one else going to question “sexburger?” Really?
lines.zh: : 没人打算问问"性汉堡"的事吗？真的？

lines.en: : Hi, Kaori! I didn’t realize you worked {i}here{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Kaori！我不知道你也{i}在这儿{/i}上班。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo26
: Ah! It is the tiny red human who once exited the phallus of my Friend as a sperm! How are-
lines.zh: : 啊！这不是那位曾经以精子的形态、从我朋友那根阳具里出来的红色小人吗！你最近——

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo27
: ...Kaori? Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : ……Kaori？你还好吗？

lines.en: : I...I don’t...know...
lines.zh: : 我……我不……知道……

lines.en: : Kaori, could you bring us some water, please? We’re not ready to order yet. And-
lines.zh: : Kaori，能给我们拿点水吗？我们还没准备好点单。还有——

lines.en: : And a bottle of whatever your most expensive wine is. What does everybody else want?
lines.zh: : 再来一瓶你们这儿最贵的葡萄酒。其他人想喝点什么？

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo28
: Please don’t drink an entire bottle of wine at dinner.
lines.zh: : 拜托你别在晚餐上喝掉一整瓶葡萄酒。

lines.en: : Dad, is something wrong with Kaori? This is starting to feel like that time we saw her in the rain.
lines.zh: : 爸，Kaori 是不是有什么不对劲？这感觉开始有点像上次我们在雨里见到她那次了。

lines.en: : She’ll be fine. Kaori — water, please?
lines.zh: : 她会没事的。Kaori——水，麻烦了？

lines.en: : R...Right...
: I’ll be right back with the...with the water...
lines.zh: : 我马上就回来，拿……拿水……

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo29
: So how did {i}you{/i} get roped into this, Otoha? Aunt Niki doesn’t normally invite other people to come eat with us.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}是怎么被拉进来的，Otoha？Niki 阿姨一般不请别人来跟我们一起吃饭的。

lines.en: : Good question. I was just wondering that myself.
lines.zh: : 问得好。我自己也正在想这个。

lines.en: : She must really like you, huh?
lines.zh: : 她一定真的很喜欢你吧？

lines.en: : Or {i}hate{/i} me for subjecting me to this brand of chaotic dysfunction. I’ll take this over eating with my parents though, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者是{i}恨{/i}我，所以才让我受这种混乱又失能的罪的。不过我猜，总比跟我爸妈一起吃强。

lines.en: : Why do you say that? Family shouldn’t be taken for granted, Otoha. You never know when you might lose them.
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么说？家人不该被当成理所当然的，Otoha。你永远不知道什么时候会失去他们。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo30
: No, I get that. And sorry for making it sound that way.
lines.zh: : 不，我懂的。抱歉，我说得像是那个意思。

lines.en: : I just mean that this entire {i}thing{/i} feels kind of weird to me since I’m just not really used to it. I’d normally just scarf something down during piano lessons when I was younger. Instead of eating with my parents, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，这整件{i}事{/i}对我来说有点奇怪，因为我不太习惯。我小时候一般是在钢琴课上随便扒两口。我是说，不是跟爸妈一起吃。

lines.en: : I see what you mean I think. Dinner at my house was normally just me and Sensei and sometimes Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我大概懂你意思了。我家的晚餐通常就只有我和老师，有时候还有 Ayane。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo31
: Dinner at my place was always an {i}experience.{/i} Right, babe?
lines.zh: : 我家的晚餐永远是一场{i}体验{/i}。对吧，亲爱的？

lines.en: : You don’t remember, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不记得了，是吧？

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo32
: We {i}always{/i} ate together. Akira too when he wasn’t off getting...tutored. And my parents were {i}amazing{/i} cooks. You’ve been to the restaurant, right Otoha?
lines.zh: : 我们{i}一直{/i}是一起吃饭的。Akira 也是，只要他没跑出去接受……辅导。我爸妈的厨艺{i}好得不得了{/i}。你去过那家餐厅吧，Otoha？

lines.en: : Just once with Noriko. You two look {i}just{/i} like your mom. It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 只跟 Noriko 去过一次。你们俩长得{i}简直{/i}跟你妈一模一样。挺怪的。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo33
: Yeah...Ami too.
lines.zh: : 是啊……Ami 也是。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo34
: Heheh! You really think so?! She was, like, {i}way{/i} prettier than I’ll ever be, though. And my hair was way longer until I, well...you know. Scissors. Stab. Bad.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿！你真这么想？！不过她可比我漂亮{i}多了{/i}，我这辈子都比不上。而且我以前头发长得多，直到我，嗯……你知道的。剪刀。捅。惨。

lines.en: : Your mom was...a poet. Right?
lines.zh: : 你妈妈是……位诗人。对吧？

lines.en: : Otoha-
lines.zh: : Otoha——

lines.en: : It’s fine, Dad. I’m okay! And yes! Not just {i}a{/i} poet, though. She was {i}the{/i} poet. And she’d be super duper famous today if life was actually fair.
lines.zh: : 没事的，爸。我没事！而且对！不只是{i}一位{/i}诗人。她是{i}那位{/i}诗人。如果这世界真有公平可言，她今天早就红得发紫了。

lines.en: : Babe, want to go see if we can get a tour of the kitchen? I want to check on Kaori.
lines.zh: : 亲爱的，要不要去看看能不能参观一下厨房？我想去看看 Kaori。

lines.en: : What? But a second ago, you were-
lines.zh: : 什么？可你刚才还——

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo35
: Oh, come on. It’ll only take a second. We’ll be right back, girls! {i}Don’t be fucking weird, Ami.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哎呀，来嘛。就一会儿。我们马上回来，姑娘们！{i}Ami，别他妈搞怪。{/i}

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo36
: Joke’s on her. There’s nothing weird about being in love with your dad at all and I’m pretty sure that’s what she’s implying.
lines.zh: : 她才是开玩笑的那个。爱上自己的爸爸一点都不奇怪，我敢说她暗示的就是这个。

lines.en: : Ami...would you mind taking it a little easier on her? Niki’s sort of falling apart if you haven’t noticed.
lines.zh: : Ami……你能不能对她稍微温和一点？Niki 快撑不住了，你没注意到吗。

lines.en: : Oh, I have.
lines.zh: : 我注意到了。

lines.en: : And you just don’t care? Do you dislike her or something? Because she’s, like...really trying to make this work and you’re practically just beating her into the ground.
lines.zh: : 那你就是毫不在乎？你讨厌她还是怎么的？因为她……真的很努力想让这事成，而你简直就是把她往死里踩。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo37
: Oh, is that why you’re here? Is she trying to appeal to me using someone my age as bait this time?
lines.zh: : 哦，所以你就是为这个来的？这次她是想用个跟我同龄的人当诱饵来打动我？

lines.en: : What’s your deal, dude? Why are you so hostile to her when she’s practically family already? You’re not like this to Noriko.
lines.zh: : 你到底怎么回事，老兄？她都快算是一家人了，你干嘛对她这么敌视？你对 Noriko 可不这样。

lines.en: : That’s because Noriko isn’t disrupting the ecosystem. If you just decided to move into my house one day, I’d make your life miserable too.
lines.zh: : 因为 Noriko 没有破坏生态平衡。要是你哪天突然搬进我家，我也会把你的生活弄得很惨。

lines.en: : So it’s just her sort of...assuming the role of a matriarch that gets you all riled up?
lines.zh: : 所以只是她那种……扮演女家长的角色让你炸毛？

lines.en: : Not really. Like, I’d be fine with somebody like Sana’s mom moving in since I know she wouldn’t judge me the way Niki does.
lines.zh: : 也不全是。比如，要是 Sana 的妈妈搬进来，我就无所谓，因为我知道她不会像 Niki 那样评判我。

lines.en: : You don’t think Sana’s mom would judge you for wanting to bone your dad?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Sana 的妈妈不会因为你想操你爸而评判你？

lines.en: : I don’t, no. And I know that for a fact because I told her about it while she was cutting my hair and she just smiled and said “that’s nice.”
lines.zh: : 不会，真不会。而且我确凿知道这一点，因为我剪头发的时候跟她说了，她就笑了笑，说了句"挺好的"。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo38
: Not exactly a five star review of your outlook.
lines.zh: : 对你的观念来说，这可算不上五星好评。

lines.en: : No, but it’s not a rejection either! And there’s nothing more annoying to me than people who think {i}their{/i} outlook on controversial subjects is the only morally good one!
lines.zh: : 是算不上，可那也不是拒绝啊！对我来说，最烦的就是那种觉得自己对争议话题的{i}看法{/i}才是唯一道德正确的人！

lines.en: : So if Niki was open to the idea of you and Akira-
lines.zh: : 那如果 Niki 对你和 Akira 的事持开放态度——

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo39
: Then she would stop feeling my wrath!
lines.zh: : 那她就不用再承受我的怒火了！

lines.en: : What? Are {i}you{/i} judging me now, too?
lines.zh: : 什么？{i}你{/i}现在也要评判我了吗？

lines.en: : A little bit, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有一点，是的。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo40
: Okay, shotacon. Whatever you say.
lines.zh: : 好吧，正太控。随你怎么说。

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo41
: {i}Can you knock it out with that, please?!{/i} It was one thing during the Dorm Wars, but I don’t need you saying that every single time we interact from now on!
lines.zh: : {i}你能不能别再提这个了，拜托？！{/i} 宿舍大战那会儿说一次就算了，我可不需要你以后每次跟我说话都要来一遍！

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like I’m going to {i}tell{/i} anyone.
lines.zh: : 我又不会{i}告诉{/i}别人。

lines.en: : That just makes it sounds like I’m {i}admitting{/i} to...being that thing you said!
lines.zh: : 那听起来反倒像是我在{i}承认{/i}……你说的那种东西！

lines.en: : Ooooooh...I didn’t realize you were like my dad in trying to pretend you’re {i}not{/i} interested in things you {i}are{/i} interested in. Sorry, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 哦——————原来你跟我爸一样，都喜欢假装自己对明明{i}有兴趣{/i}的东西{i}没{/i}兴趣。抱歉啊，Otoha。

lines.en: : That implies I’m a creep too, idiot!
lines.zh: : 那等于说我也是个变态，白痴！

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo42
: Do you think my mom was a creep, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我妈是变态吗，Otoha？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I just figured you’d empathize with her outlook a little more as one of her fans.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，作为她的粉丝之一，你应该更能理解她的观念。

lines.en: : I........never said I was one of her fans.
lines.zh: : 我…………从没说过我是她的粉丝。

lines.en: : But you are, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 可你就是，对吧？

lines.en: : And you know who my dad is...right?
lines.zh: : 而且你知道我爸是谁……对吧？

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo43
: Hah! It just occurred to me how funny it is that you’ve probably been masturbating to him since before you two even met! You really {i}do{/i} stand out after all, huh?!
lines.zh: : 哈！我刚想到一件事真好笑——你大概早在你俩认识之前就已经对着他自慰了吧！你还{i}真是{/i}与众不同啊，是吧？！

lines.en: : {i}Ami! Shut up! Not everybody is as comfortable with being fucked up as you are!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Ami！闭嘴！不是所有人都像你一样对自己的变态安之若素！{/i}

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo44
: It’s {i}not{/i} fucked up, though. I mean, I’m sure that {i}sometimes{/i} it is, yeah. But, as a fellow {i}reader,{/i} you surely understand just how dearly they loved one another, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 可那{i}并不{/i}变态啊。我是说，{i}有时候{/i}确实变态，对。但作为同样的一位{i}读者{/i}，你肯定懂他们有多深爱着彼此，不是吗？

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo45
: And if {i}you{/i} had a little boy to love like that, surely {i}you’d{/i} be bending over some couch and letting him put his tiny little-
lines.zh: : 而如果{i}你{/i}也有一个可以那样去爱的小男孩，想必{i}你{/i}也会趴在某张沙发上，让他把他小小的——

lines.en: : Hey. Did Kaori not-
lines.zh: : 嘿。Kaori 没——

lines.en: scene otohadinnertwo46
: Why is Otoha so red? What did you say to her?
lines.zh: : Otoha 怎么这么红？你跟她说了什么？

lines.en: : Welcome back, Aunt Niki! Otoha and I were just talking about how excited we are to see you start acting! It’s going to be so weird seeing you play characters other than just {i}Niki{/i} now.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来，Niki 阿姨！我和 Otoha 正在聊，看你开始演戏我们有多激动。以后能看到你演{i}Niki{/i}以外的角色了，一定会很奇怪。

lines.en: : Oh. Well...I do suppose that explains the color of Otoha’s face, yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯……我想这倒是解释了 Otoha 脸色的成因。

lines.en: : Super excited...
lines.zh: : 超级激动……

lines.en: scene black
: Anyway, did Kaori not come by with the water? Akira and I couldn’t find her, so we figured she might have been out on the floor still. He’s still looking for her in the back.
lines.zh: : 话说，Kaori 没过来送水吗？Akira 和我没找到她，所以想着她可能还在外面。他还在后头找她呢。

lines.en: : Kaori? No, she didn’t come by at all. I hope she’s okay, though. You don’t think she got sick, do you?
lines.zh: : Kaori？没有，她根本没来过。不过我希望她没事。你该不会觉得她生病了吧？

lines.en: : Let me text her. I’m pretty sure I still have her number somewhere.
lines.zh: : 我给她发个短信。我挺确定我哪儿还存着她的号码。

lines.en: : I think I’m going to...step outside for a minute to get some air...
lines.zh: : 我想我得……出去待一会儿透透气……

lines.en: : Okay, but if you leave me here I am never teaching you anything ever again.
lines.zh: : 行啊，但你要是把我一个人扔在这儿，我这辈子再也不会教你任何东西了。

lines.en: : I’m not convinced you were ever going to anyway...
lines.zh: : 我也没信过你本来就会教……

lines.en: $ otohaspring5 = True
$ otoha_love += 1
$ niki_love += 1
$ ami_love += 1
jump otohaspring6
